title: Nell and the Jug
checkpoint: Reception Autumn 2, week 4 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds j, v, w
note_for_grown_ups: A true fact for this one: bees really do visit water, not just flowers, especially on a hot day — exactly what Nell is doing at the jug.

pages.illustration: Nell the bee landing on the rim of a watering jug in the vegetable patch.
Close view of water glistening around the rim of the jug.
Nell the bee settling carefully on the wet rim of the jug.
Nell the bee dipping down to sip a little water from the jug's rim.
Nell the bee sipping again and again, clearly thirsty on a hot day.
Nell the bee pausing, checking her balance on the rim before sipping once more.
Nell the bee sipping calmly and steadily, perfectly balanced on the jug.

pages.text: Nell is not sad. Nell has fun at the jug.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee resting happily on the jug rim in the sun, refreshed.
